english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an outcome that happens in the end.

exampleSentences.english: I waited for you for so long, and eventually you agreed.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我等咗你好耐，最後你都肯答應。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dang2 zo2 nei5 hou2 noi6 zeoi3 hau6 nei5 dou1 hang2 daap3 jing3

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a neutral “ultimately,” including the last item in a list and the final outcome.

exampleSentences.english: Ultimately, we decided to take a taxi home.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我哋最後決定搭的士返屋企。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zeoi3 hau6 kyut3 ding6 daap3 dik1 si2 faan1 uk1 kei2

english.note: Use this for doing something finally or at the end of a process.

exampleSentences.english: I understood at last that I was the one who had made a mistake.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我最後先明白原來係我搞錯。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 hau6 sin1 ming4 baak6 jyun4 loi4 hai6 ngo5 gaau2 co3

english.note: Use this for the eventual outcome or for the last item or action, rather than the sense of relief in 終於.

exampleSentences.english: We finally decided to take a taxi.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zeoi3 hau6 kyut3 ding6 daap3 dik1 si2
